description: Official Czech company check from the ARES register (Ministry of Finance, open data). Look up by ICO (exact) or search by name (up to 5 candidates). Returns official name, legal form code, VAT number (DIC), establishment and termination dates, registered address and NACE activity codes, with a direct ARES link. Companies only.

ico.description: 8-digit Czech ICO (exact), e.g. 45274649; provide this or 'name'

name.description: Company name to search (up to 5 candidates)

name: check_cz_company
